Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
EthIf_SwitchMacSecUpdateSecYNotification (draft)
Syntax
void EthIf_SwitchMacSecUpdateSecYNotification (
const EthSwt_MgmtInfoType* MgmtInfoPtr,
Std_ReturnType Result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x6b
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different MgmtInfoPtr, Non reentrant for the same MgmtInfoPtr
MgmtInfoPtr
Pointer to the management information within the context of an
Ethernet Switch Driver. SwitchIdx in context of the EthIf (EthIf
Switch/EthIfSwitchIdx), PortIdx in context of EthSwt (EthSwtPort/
EthSwtPortIdx).
Parameters (in)
Result
E_OK: EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY has finished and SecY is
updated with the provided parameters of EthSwt_MacSecUpdate
SecY
E_NOT_OK: SecY has not been updated with the provided
parameters of EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Callback to notify that EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY has finished.
